snippet.title: A MINECRAFT MOVIE DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventure deeper into A MINECRAFT MOVIE! Enter the arcade solo or with friends to compete in elytra races, survive the night, and sneak into a woodland mansion. Can you reach the top of the leaderboard and earn the trophy? Get the DLC for free at Minecraft Marketplace and show your skills in iconic moments from the movie!
 
 
Get the DLC for free here: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp?id=069b2db5-5164-48ba-afb2-e95d81aa763f 
 
Learn more about the DLC: https://www.minecraft.net/article/a-minecraft-movie-dlc
